'''Revenant goblins''' are a type of monster that inhabit the [[Forinthry Dungeon]] along with all other [[revenants]]. The Forinthry Dungeon is a part of the [[Wilderness]] so it is possible to be attacked by other players here if opted into [[PvP]].

Like all revenants, they can restore life points quickly, can cure themselves of [[poison]] and react quickly to a player's [[protection prayer]]s. When below 50% health, revenant goblins will "eat" to heal 1/6th their maximum life points from their limited supply of food. For a full description of the healing mechanic see the [[Revenants#Overview|revenants]] page.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

All four variants of the revenant goblin have the same drops, but as revenant drop chances depend on the combat level of the revenant, the chances change between the variants.

Revenant drops are not affected by [[luck]]. There are only two ways to increase the drop rate of revenant items: completion of the [[elite Wilderness achievements]] which gives a 5% increased chance for revenant drops, and [[revenant drop enhancer]]s, which give a 10% increased chance. Both boosts can be in effect at the same time.

==Trivia==
* Revenant goblins used to have two different looks, with the variables being that they either had or hadn't had a helm and/or mohawk. After an update, Revenant goblins were updated and have a much more similar resemblance to their [[God Wars]] counterparts.
* Revenant goblins are the third updated Revenant. The first was the [[Revenant dragon]], and the second was the [[Revenant hobgoblin]].
* While in the Forinthry Dungeon, Revenant goblins had the second slowest respawn rate out of all of the revenants, only the Revenant vampyre having the slowest spawn rate. This was changed in an hidden update, which slightly increased their respawn rate.
